$comment: Register seeya-mcp as a local MCP server in opencode.json. Adjust `cwd` to this repo's absolute path. Only the backends you use need their key; the server starts without any keys and reports a missing key only when you select a backend that needs it. Do NOT set OPENCODE_BASE_URL unless you run your own `opencode serve` on a known port -- by default the opencode backend spawns its own server, so it does not need the TUI's (random, undiscoverable) port. See the README 'opencode connectivity' section.
